])

slot_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['pixels'] == 16 and 20 <= min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) <= 40]
print("After swaps:")
for n in slot_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"  r={min_r}, c={min_c}: color={n['color']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
